items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: I just played with him. I wasn't recording with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, Buddy told me that he was hired as a singer.

That was a great band. He sang -- Buddy sang the ballads with the band. He sang pretty good. He was a nice ballad singer, but that was a very good band. So I worked with that band at Sebastian's Cotton Club there for about seven, eight years, as the house band and that's when Bing Crosby and all the guys out of the Gus Arnheim Band and that group, they used to come out when Louis Armstrong was fronting our band. He came out a couple of times, Louis, and that's when he made "Just a Gigolo" and "Stardust," and all…
So you were in that band behind him? (inaudible)?
